name: What happens after a preventive roof maintenance inspection?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a preventive roof maintenance inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a preventive roof maintenance inspection, Discounted Roofing Co. will provide you with a detailed report outlining our findings, including any areas of concern, photos, and recommended repairs or maintenance tasks. We will then discuss these recommendations with you, prioritize necessary work, and provide a transparent estimate for any suggested services. This allows you to make informed decisions about your roof's care, extending its life and protecting your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: After inspection, you'll receive a detailed report with findings, photos, and recommended repairs. We'll discuss these, prioritize work, and provide an estimate for any services.
